title: Output Growth Is Not A Just Productive Transformation
summary: From production through capability, productivity, quality, job dignity, domestic value, diversification, decarbonization, circularity, resilience, convergence and legitimacy.
map_question: What records are required before output growth is not a just productive transformation can support a bounded development or transformation decision?
interpretation_boundary: Subsidy volume is not additional productive capacity. Firm attraction is not rooted regional development. Patent count is not innovation diffusion. Export complexity is not shared prosperity. Infrastructure spending is not an executable production ecosystem. Output growth is not a just productive transformation.

what_this_map_supports: Separate mission, instrument, innovation, diffusion, cluster, supplier, workforce, convergence and transformation decisions.
Explicit authority, identities, baselines, counterfactuals, constraints, conditions, capabilities, distribution, due process, uncertainty, challenge and review.
Public reasoning without firm, worker, community, region, sector, technology, supplier, institution, jurisdiction or country scoring or ranking.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not select a mission, sector, firm, instrument, technology, cluster, corridor, supplier, worker, transition, or place.
It does not convert subsidies, attraction, patents, exports, infrastructure spending or output growth into outcomes.
It does not create a receipt, score, rank, stage advance or operating-outcome change.
next_records_needed: A verified Phase 92 fiscal, trade, supply-resilience, distribution and macroeconomic-legitimacy chain.
Separately adopted mission, innovation, regional-development and productive-transformation decisions.
Independent additionality, diffusion, capability, job-quality, convergence, distribution, resilience, correction and propagation receipts.
